        while q:
          x,y=q.pop(); cells.append((x,y))
          for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            a,b=x+dx,y+dy
            if 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and (a,b) not in seen and grid[a][b]==col:

    # transfer key color to the other 3-cell L; in these boards it is the
    # motif whose orientation matches the key's elbow (not the nearest one).
    # Find triomino Ls and choose one with same orientation signature.
    def signature(cells):
      rr=[r for r,c in cells]; cc=[c for r,c in cells]
      pts={(r-min(rr),c-min(cc)) for r,c in cells}

    ks=signature(keycells)

    # use the 3-cell L shape among other components; closest to key is a tie-breaker
    cand=[]
    for col,cells in comps:

      rr=[r for r,c in cells]; cc=[c for r,c in cells]
      if max(rr)-min(rr)!=1 or max(cc)-min(cc)!=1: continue
      # connected L triomino (not diagonal / straight)
      pts={(r-min(rr),c-min(cc)) for r,c in cells}
      if len(pts)==3 and any(len([p for p in pts if p[0]==i])==2 for i in (0,1)) and any(len([p for p in pts if p[1]==j])==2 for j in (0,1)):

        cand.append((d,cells))
    if cand:

      # closest matching triomino is the one to recolor.
